text: I would love to give it 5 stars, is exactly what I need and is well made. BUT the fact that you can't input past days without paying ruins it. forgot to record the activity(or come from another app)? goodbye streak. the developer needs to gain something (I'm an app developer too so I get it) but the price for the lifetime is outrageous. so here's my two cents: either move the retroactive inputting to the free tier (the other features are fine there) or lower the lifetime price, 40$ is too high
author: Daniele ziaco
developer_reply: Hi Daniele, thank you for your feedback! I hear you, I'll consider lowering the lifetime price of the app. - Adrien

text: Sembra essere l'app che cercavo, strutturata in stile Duolingo per la registrazione delle abitudini, però presenta ancora qualche bug, come ad esempio il widget che non funziona. Ha però indubbiamente del potenziale: se ottimizzata, sono disposto a cambiare la mia recensione in una positiva.
author: Francesco Rolfo
developer_reply: Grazie Francesco per il tuo feedback, sto lavorando per migliorare i widget. - Adrien

text: Really cute and does exactly what I was looking for. However, 3 habits is just too little to the point where the app becomes impossible to use. I understand tho you need to make money, but I think limiting the free version to 3 habits is going to turn a lot of people away, so maybe there's something else you can do? Idk.
author: Magou Salla Gueye
developer_reply: Hi Magou, thank you for taking the time to write such a feedback, I appreciate it. If you have any idea about how I could monetize better without the free habits limit, please let me know at contact.adrienblc@gmail.com. - Adrien

text: L'app sembra molto bella ma non funzionano i widget sul mio android. Sono pronta a cambiare il mio voto se dovessero funzionare, perché sembra esattamente l'app che stavo cercando!
author: Anna Esposito
developer_reply: Grazie per il tuo feedback. Puoi inviarmi ulteriori informazioni a contact.adrienblc@gmail.com in modo che possa eseguire il debug del problema? - Adrien

text: App molto bella ma 3 abitudini per la versione gratis è poco
author: Emma El Battawi
developer_reply: Grazie mille per il tuo feedback Emma. Sto cercando di bilanciare l'offerta gratuita con quella a pagamento. Se avete altre idee, non esitate a contattarmi a contact.adrienblc@gmail.com. - Adrien

text: The app does what I hoped. I was looking for a streak counter as effective as the one on duolingo. The icon is on point. For future updates I would add the streak on the widgets. It could be good to make it as in the app [current streak 🔥 | best streak 🔥]. With the flame too. In my opinion the image is psychologically important. If the widget is added, I'll rate 5 stars! Cheers! Edit: Thank you! I like the minimal style of the widget!
author: Alessandro C.
developer_reply: Thanks for your detailed feedback! I'm glad Habits Streak meets your needs. Great news - I just released widgets in version 1.14.0! Please update your app to try them out. If you have any other suggestions, feel free to email me at contact.adrienblc@gmail.com. - Adrien
